import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    return ((p[0] + p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*t) + p[3]*t)/P + p[4] + p[5]*t + p[6]*P
            + p[7]*P*P + p[8]*t*P + p[9]*t*t)
